What I did — `SettingsScreen` now re-checks notification permission status and retries the StoreKit product lookup on every `scenePhase` transition to `.active`, not just once at first appearance. Honest gap, same as every round: none of this is exercisable end-to-end yet since `AuraStore.todayEntry()` still always returns `nil` — Settings/StoreKit/notifications are solid in isolation, but there's still no real card, no persistence, and no generative engine behind any of it.
